Indian Standard ( Reaffirmed 2002 ) 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
TEE COUPLING ASSEMBLIES FOR 
OIL-HYDRAULIC SYSTEMS 



1. Scope — Specifies the dimensions and other requirements for tee coupling assemblies used in 
oil-hydraulic systems. 

2. Types 

2.1 Type A — Covers the assembly for taper male stud tee bodies for sizes up to and including 18 mm. 

2.2 Type B — Covers the assembly for male stud tee bodies for sizes above 18 mm. 

2.3 Type C — Covers the assembly for equal tee bodies. 

3. Dimensions — Shall be as given in Table 1. 

4. Assembly Details 

4.1 A taper male stud tee coupling assembly consists of ferrules (conforming to IS : 8802-1978 
'Specification for ferrules for oil hydraulic coupling'), coupling nut (conforming to IS : 8803-1978 
'Specification for coupling nuts for oil-hydraulic couplings') and taper male stud tee body [conforming 
to IS : 9724-1981 Specification for taper male stud tee body for oil-hydraulic couplings, Part I Made 
from forgings or Part II Made from bar stock as agreed to between the user and the manufacturer ]. 

4.2 Type B — A male stud tee coupling assembly consists of ferrules ( conforming to IS : 8802-1 978 ), 
coupling nut (conforming to IS : 8803-1978) and male stud tee body [conforming to IS : 9725 
Specification for male stud tee body (stud branch) for oil-hydraulic couplings, Part I Made from 
forgings 06 Part II Made from bar stock as agreed to between the user and the manufacturer ]. 

4.3 Type C — An equal tee coupling assembly consists of ferrules (conforming to IS : 8802-1978 ) 
coupling nut (conforming to : IS : 8803-1978) and equal tee body (conforming to IS : 9389-1979 
'Specification for equal tee body for oil-hydraulic couplings, Part I Made from forging or Part II 
Made from bar stock' as agreed to between the user and the manufacturer). 

5. General Requirements — For details not covered in this standard, reference shall be made to 
IS : 8805 (Part I )-1 978 'General requirements for ferrule type couplings used in oil hydraulic 
systems, Part I General'. 

6. Designation — A tee coupling assembly of Type A of light series L for outside diameter of 
tube 6 mm and conforming to this standard shall be designated as: 

Tee Coupling AL6 IS : 9767 



EXPLAN ATO R Y NOTE
